newsitem.title: UK: European jet jumps with gas oil futures.
newsitem.headline: European jet jumps with gas oil futures.

text.p: European jet fuel gained up to $4 a tonne on Tuesday on the back of stronger IPE gas oil futures reversing Monday's losses.
Premiums were largely untouched in a thin market.
March IPE gas oil closed $3.50 up at $163.50, having been propelled higher in part because of some bargain hunting after recent losses.
Barges were assessed down at March IPE gas oil +$20-21 fob ARA, about $1 off Monday's levels while cargoes were notionally put around March IPE gas oil +$23.
"There is not any real interest for cargoes," said one broker.
